S14-B05/01.transcript: It was faster at runtime, it had a real object system with inheritance, and Borland's component model was arguably better than Ivan B's.

S14-B06/01.transcript: Delphi never caught VB in market share, though. VB had Microsoft behind it, and Microsoft controlled the operating system. VB was the default. If you were a self-taught programmer or a small business writing internal tools, you used VB, because everyone else used VB.
